title: Listing Highlight: 41' Valhalla V-41 2026
description: Explore the 2026 Valhalla V-41, a 41-foot center console with quad Mercury V-10-425 engines delivering 1,700 hp. Located in Coral Gables, Florida.
html:
Quad Mercury Engines Power This 41-Foot Valhalla in Coral Gables

The 2026 Valhalla V-41 represents a compelling entry point into a newer, high-performance center console platform from a builder renowned for engineering and seaworthiness. This 41-foot vessel combines the practical design Valhalla is known for with modern construction and proven propulsion, making it an attractive option for buyers seeking capability without excessive age.

Valhalla has built its reputation on creating center consoles that balance comfort, performance, and reliability. The V-41 carries forward that tradition with an 11.58-foot beam that provides stability and usable deck space. The fiberglass hull construction ensures durability and low maintenance, while the layout prioritizes both fishing functionality and cruising comfort. At just over 40 feet, the V-41 occupies a sweet spot for owners who want a serious offshore platform without the complexity of larger vessels. Power comes from four Mercury V-10-425 outboard engines, each producing 425 horsepower, for a combined total of 1,700 hp. This quad-engine setup is the performance standard for the V-41 and delivers the acceleration and top-end speed Valhalla owners expect. With only 70 total hours on the engines, this vessel has barely been broken in, suggesting minimal wear and excellent mechanical condition. The outboard configuration offers advantages in shallow-water operation, ease of maintenance, and the ability to trim up in skinny water.

Fuel capacity stands at 557 gallons, providing substantial range for extended offshore runs or multi-day cruising. Water capacity of 49 gallons and a 12-gallon holding tank round out the essential systems. These specifications reflect the V-41's design as a serious cruising platform, not merely a day boat. The combination of fuel capacity and engine efficiency means owners can venture well offshore with confidence. The vessel is located in Coral Gables, Florida, placing it in one of the most active yachting markets in the United States. This location offers immediate access to the Atlantic, the Bahamas, and the broader Caribbean, making it ideal for buyers planning regular offshore adventures. FYI Yachts has listed this 2026 model as a used vessel, offering the advantage of a newer platform with the pricing flexibility of the pre-owned market.

Key specifications include a length of 41 feet (12.3 meters) and a beam of 11.58 feet. The fiberglass construction ensures longevity and resistance to the marine environment. As a 2026 model, this V-41 incorporates the latest design refinements and manufacturing standards from Valhalla, meaning buyers receive a contemporary vessel with modern systems and materials.

For buyers evaluating center consoles in this size range, the V-41 offers proven engineering, strong resale value, and the kind of performance credentials that appeal to both fishing enthusiasts and cruising-minded owners. The quad Mercury engine package is a significant asset, as it represents the factory-standard power setup and ensures parts availability and service support across the United States. Whether you are upgrading from a smaller center console or stepping into the category for the first time, this vessel merits serious consideration.
